description: Pakistan PVC Limited, which sells under the SHAVYL name, runs a chlor-alkali and PVC complex producing PVC resins and processing those and other thermoplastic compounds into finished and semi-finished products. The plant is at Shaffiabad, Gharo in Thatta district, 66 km from Karachi, with a second facility for pipes and fittings. The complex was built in the mid-1960s in collaboration with Shin-Etsu Chemical and Sekisui Chemical of Japan, and the company began producing PVC pipes in 1966. Its pipe plant has since been rebuilt around extrusion machinery from Toshiba, Wavin and Sekisui.
headOffice: Sector I-9, Industrial Area, Islamabad, Pakistan
